Issues:

- Mockito imports missing; we can remove Mockito usage because not needed. There is a @Mock field outputFormatMock but not used. Remove Mockito imports, annotation, field.

- SimpleOutputFormat implements OutputFormat<Object>. Need to see interface OutputFormat. Likely has method format(JsonSchema, Set<ValidationMessage>, ExecutionContext, ValidationContext) maybe. In errors: "SimpleOutputFormat is not abstract and does not override abstract method format(JsonSchema,Set<ValidationMessage>,ExecutionContext,ValidationContext) in OutputFormat". So OutputFormat is a functional interface with method format(...). In code they used apply(ValidationResult). So we need to adapt to correct method signature.

Let's inspect typical OutputFormat in networknt schema library. I recall there is interface OutputFormat<T> with method T format(JsonSchema schema, Set<ValidationMessage> messages, ExecutionContext executionContext, ValidationContext validationContext). Actually ValidationContext maybe a class. Let's search memory: In networknt json-schema-validator library, OutputFormat is used for walk method. I think signature: T format(JsonSchema schema, Set<ValidationMessage> messages, ExecutionContext executionContext, ValidationContext validationContext). So we need to implement that.

Simplify: In tests they only care that OutputFormat is invoked once and returns whatever they set. So we can implement SimpleOutputFormat that implements OutputFormat<Object> and stores a Function<Set<ValidationMessage>, Object> maybe ignoring other params. Or we can implement format method that increments callCount and returns function.apply(messages). We'll need to import appropriate types.

Also ExecutionContextCustomizer interface requires method customize(ExecutionContext ctx) maybe also ValidationContext? Error: "does not override abstract method customize(ExecutionContext,ValidationContext)". So need to implement both parameters.

Implement TestCustomizer implements ExecutionContextCustomizer with method customize(ExecutionContext ctx, ValidationContext vc) { invokeCount++; }

Also need to adjust imports: remove Mockito.

Ambiguous walk method: there are two overloads: one taking OutputFormat<T> and ExecutionContextCustomizer; another taking OutputFormat<T> and Consumer<ExecutionContext>. The call with null for 5th argument ambiguous because both accept null. Need to cast null to appropriate type. Use (ExecutionContextCustomizer) null.

Similarly for calls with customizer variable of type TestCustomizer which implements ExecutionContextCustomizer, but still ambiguous because also matches Consumer<ExecutionContext>. Need to cast to ExecutionContextCustomizer.

Thus modify calls: schema.walk(executionContext, node, outputFormat, false, (ExecutionContextCustomizer) null); etc.

Also for calls with customizer: schema.walk(..., (ExecutionContextCustomizer) customizer);

Now other errors: ValidationMessage.of method not found. In library, ValidationMessage has static method of(String) maybe not. Actually ValidationMessage has static method of(String message) maybe in newer versions. If not, we can create ValidationMessage manually: new ValidationMessage.Builder().message("custom: ...").build()? Simpler: use ValidationMessage.builder().message(...).build()? Not sure. Let's check typical class: ValidationMessage has static method of(String message) maybe exists. But compilation says not. So we need alternative.

Looking at library, ValidationMessage has a constructor ValidationMessage(String message) maybe. I think there is a static method of(String) in newer version. In older version maybe builder. Let's search memory: In networknt json-schema-validator 1.0.71, ValidationMessage has fields like type, path, message. There is static method of(String message) returning ValidationMessage with default type etc. Not sure.

Simpler: we can avoid using of method; we can create ValidationMessage manually using ValidationMessage.builder().message(...).build(); but need builder class.

Let's open memory: I recall ValidationMessage has static method of(String message) in version 1.0.71. But compilation says not found, maybe using older version where method is called of(String, String) or something. Let's inspect typical signature: ValidationMessage.builder().type("custom").path("").message("custom: ...").build();

But easiest: Use ValidationMessage.builder().message("custom: added by ExecutionContextCustomizer").build(); Need import.

Let's adjust.

Also need to import Set, HashSet etc already.

Now adjust SimpleOutputFormat: implement OutputFormat<Object> with method format(JsonSchema schema, Set<ValidationMessage> messages, ExecutionContext executionContext, ValidationContext validationContext). We'll need to import ValidationContext class.

We can store Function<Set<ValidationMessage>, Object> function.

format(...): callCount++; return function.apply(messages);

Provide setFunction to set function.

Now adjust test code to use setFunction accordingly: earlier they used outputFormat.setFunction(vr -> "formatted-result"); Now function expects Set<ValidationMessage>. So modify calls: outputFormat.setFunction(vr -> "formatted-result"); still works because vr is Set<ValidationMessage>. So rename param.

Thus change setFunction signature: setFunction(Function<Set<ValidationMessage>, Object> f)

Now adjust usage.
